# 3. Did EBP/CDEP services impact clinical and functional outcomes for clients who participated?

## 3.02 Was there meaningful change in intervention scores as assessed by validated outcomes tools, or were scores above clinical cut-offs at discharge?

**Inclusion criteria:** 1. must have initial time point data (i.e., be enrolled in an intervention), 2. must have a valid assessment collected at both intake and discharge time points, and 3. limited to tools with a clinical cut-off.

**Tools included:** SDQ total difficulties (four versions), Y-OQ 30.2 (caregiver and self-report), P-OQ, and CPSS-5 (interviewer and self-report). On each, a lower score is better and a score at or above the cut-off is in the clinical range. NOMS, PSS, and BASIS-24 have no published clinical cut-off and are left out. PSC-35 and CATS-2 have cut-offs but are not included (see the note at the end).

**Calculation:** For each tool, pairs of initial and follow-up scores are cross-tabulated by whether each score is in the clinical range. For tools with a reliable change index (Y-OQ and P-OQ), each pair is also classed as a reliable improvement, no reliable change, or a reliable worsening; a reliable improvement that moves the score from the clinical range to below the cut-off is a clinically significant improvement (Jacobson and Truax).

**Assumptions:** The cleaned paired files already exclude dates before 2024-01-01 and after the run date and pair each initial assessment to the LAST follow-up. Pairs with either score missing are left out.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE, knitr.kable.NA = "", scipen = 999)
```

```{r}
#| label: config
# Defaults are used when running chunks interactively; YAML params take precedence when rendering.
defaults <- list(
  data_dir   = "~/Dropbox-CWS/Cristin Young/CYBHI Project/Rebecca and Tristan and Cristin/EInsight Data",
  output_dir = "output/sq302",
  suppress_n = 60,
  shareable  = FALSE
)
cfg <- modifyList(defaults, if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) as.list(params) else list())

# Shareable render: counts of 1 to SUPPRESS_N - 1 are suppressed in every results table (with
# complementary suppression), and QA counts of 1 to SUPPRESS_N - 1 display as "<SUPPRESS_N". The
# default (internal) render shows exact counts and must not be shared.
SUPPRESS_N <- as.integer(cfg$suppress_n)
SHAREABLE  <- isTRUE(as.logical(cfg$shareable))
RUN_MODE   <- if (SHAREABLE) "SHAREABLE" else "INTERNAL"
SUPPR      <- "Suppr."
NOT_REPORTED <- "Not reported / missing"
FILE_TAG   <- "sq302"            # prefix of every file this script writes

# Tools with a published clinical cut-off, one row per version. On every tool a lower score is
# better and a score at or above `cutoff` is in the clinical range. `rci` is the tool's reliable
# change index (NA where none is published). `file` is the cleaned paired file, with the initial and
# follow-up scores in the `initial` and `follow_up` columns. Sources (project files):
#   SDQ     total difficulties, four-band cut-points: the first score above "close to average"
#           (SDQ_EnglishUK_2-4scoring.pdf, SDQ_English_4-17scoring.pdf).
#   Y-OQ    30.2 manual: cut-off 29 (parent report) and 30 (self-report), RCI 10.
#   P-OQ    manual: cut-off 47, RCI 7.
#   CPSS-5  psychometric description: 31 identifies probable PTSD.
# NOMS, PSS, and BASIS-24 have no clinical cut-off and are not included.
MEASURES <- tribble(
  ~id,             ~measure,                     ~file,                            ~initial,        ~follow_up,        ~cutoff, ~rci,
  "sdq_p24",       "SDQ Parent (2-4)",           "sdq_p24_pairs_clean.csv",        "initial_total", "follow_up_total", 13,      NA,
  "sdq_p410",      "SDQ Parent (4-10)",          "sdq_p410_pairs_clean.csv",       "initial_total", "follow_up_total", 14,      NA,
  "sdq_p1117",     "SDQ Parent (11-17)",         "sdq_p1117_pairs_clean.csv",      "initial_total", "follow_up_total", 14,      NA,
  "sdq_s1117",     "SDQ Self (11-17)",           "sdq_s1117_pairs_clean.csv",      "initial_total", "follow_up_total", 15,      NA,
  "yoq_caregiver", "Y-OQ 30.2 Caregiver",        "yoq_caregiver_paired_clean.csv", "initial_score", "follow_up_score", 29,      10,
  "yoq_self",      "Y-OQ 30.2 Self-report",      "yoq_self_paired_clean.csv",      "initial_score", "follow_up_score", 30,      10,
  "poq",           "P-OQ",                       "poq_paired_clean.csv",           "initial_score", "follow_up_score", 47,      7,
  "cpss_i",        "CPSS-5 Interviewer",         "cpss_i_paired_clean.csv",        "initial_score", "follow_up_score", 31,      NA,
  "cpss_s",        "CPSS-5 Self-report",         "cpss_s_paired_clean.csv",        "initial_score", "follow_up_score", 31,      NA
)

# Labels: score relative to the cut-off (below, at or above), the four ways a pair of scores can sit
# relative to it, and the direction of a reliable change (worse, none, better).
STATUS   <- c("Below cut-off", "Clinical range")
MOVEMENT <- expand_grid(initial = rev(STATUS), follow_up = STATUS) |>
  mutate(label = paste(initial, "to", str_to_lower(follow_up)),
         recovered = initial == STATUS[2] & follow_up == STATUS[1])
RELIABLE <- c("Reliable worsening", "No reliable change", "Reliable improvement")

dir.create(cfg$output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: helpers
# Formatting, suppression, and table helpers are copied verbatim from the 1.01 script; keep them in sync.
fmt_n <- function(n) formatC(as.numeric(n), format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
fmt_n_qa <- function(n) {
  ifelse(SHAREABLE & !is.na(n) & n > 0 & n < SUPPRESS_N, paste0("<", SUPPRESS_N), fmt_n(n))
}
fmt_pct <- function(p, digits = 1) {
  ifelse(is.na(p) | is.nan(p), "", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f%%"), 100 * p))
}

# ---- Primary and complementary suppression ----
# `x` holds every published or derivable number in a table (cells and totals). Each element of `lines`
# indexes entries tied by one additive constraint, with the total LAST (a row's cells, then its total).
# Counts of 1 to k - 1 are suppressed, then more entries are suppressed until:
#   (a) no line has exactly one suppressed entry, which subtraction would recover;
#   (b) in a line whose total is shown, the suppressed cells add up to at least k, so their combined
#       count (total minus the shown cells) is not itself a small count; and
#   (c) no suppressed count below k, and no sum of two suppressed counts that is below k, can be
#       solved for exactly from all of the table's constraints taken together (checked by matrix rank).
# Extra suppressions go to the entry with the lowest `weight` (by default, the smallest count).
# An entry with weight Inf is never chosen, e.g. because another table already shows it. An entry
# that can be read off a line whose other entries are all zero or shown elsewhere cannot be
# protected, so it is never chosen either. If no entry can protect a hidden count, the render stops
# rather than publish a count that could be recovered.
pick_entry <- function(cand, weight) {
  cand <- cand[is.finite(weight[cand])]
  if (length(cand) == 0L) NA_integer_ else cand[which.min(weight[cand])]
}

recoverable_entries <- function(x, lines, s, k) {
  sup <- which(s)
  if (length(sup) == 0L) return(integer())
  A <- do.call(rbind, lapply(lines, function(ln) {
    row <- numeric(length(x))
    row[ln] <- c(rep(1, length(ln) - 1L), -1)
    row[sup]
  }))
  A <- A[rowSums(A != 0) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(A) == 0L) return(integer())
  r <- qr(A)$rank
  solvable <- function(v) qr(rbind(A, v))$rank == r
  unit <- function(j) as.numeric(seq_along(sup) == j)
  small <- which(x[sup] < k)
  hits <- sup[small[vapply(small, function(j) solvable(unit(j)), logical(1))]]
  if (length(hits) == 0L && length(small) > 1L) {
    for (pr in combn(small, 2, simplify = FALSE)) {
      if (sum(x[sup[pr]]) < k && solvable(unit(pr[1]) + unit(pr[2]))) {
        hits <- sup[pr]
        break
      }
    }
  }
  hits
}

suppress_lines <- function(x, lines, k = SUPPRESS_N, init = NULL, weight = x) {
  s <- !is.na(x) & x > 0 & x < k
  if (!is.null(init)) s <- s | init
  repeat {
    pinned <- unlist(lapply(lines, function(ln) {
      unknown <- ln[x[ln] > 0 & (is.finite(weight[ln]) | s[ln])]
      if (length(unknown) == 1L && is.finite(weight[unknown])) unknown
    }))
    if (length(pinned) == 0L) break
    weight[pinned] <- Inf
  }
  open_entries <- function(idx) idx[!s[idx] & x[idx] > 0]
  cannot_protect <- function() {
    stop("Complementary suppression cannot protect a hidden count: every entry that could be ",
         "hidden with it is zero or shown in another table.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  repeat {
    j <- NA_integer_
    for (ln in lines) {
      tot <- ln[length(ln)]
      cells <- ln[-length(ln)]
      small_sum <- !s[tot] && any(s[cells]) && sum(x[cells][s[cells]]) < k
      if (sum(s[ln]) == 1L || small_sum) {
        j <- pick_entry(open_entries(ln), weight)
        if (is.na(j)) cannot_protect()
        break
      }
    }
    if (is.na(j)) {
      rec <- recoverable_entries(x, lines, s, k)
      if (length(rec) > 0L) {
        near <- unique(unlist(lines[vapply(lines, function(ln) any(rec %in% ln), logical(1))]))
        j <- pick_entry(open_entries(near), weight)
        if (is.na(j)) j <- pick_entry(open_entries(seq_along(x)), weight)
        if (is.na(j)) cannot_protect()
      }
    }
    if (is.na(j)) break
    s[j] <- TRUE
  }
  s
}

# Suppression pattern for a matrix of counts with its totals attached: row totals in the last column
# and column totals in the last row. Every row and column is a line. Extra suppressions go to inner
# cells first, then to row totals, and to the grand total last, because hiding the grand total forces
# a column total to be hidden too. `init` marks entries that start hidden and `fixed` marks entries
# that are never hidden, usually because another table hides or shows the same number.
suppress_table <- function(ext, init = FALSE, fixed = FALSE) {
  R <- nrow(ext) - 1L
  C <- ncol(ext) - 1L
  idx <- matrix(seq_along(ext), nrow(ext))
  lines <- c(lapply(seq_len(R + 1L), function(i) idx[i, ]),
             lapply(seq_len(C + 1L), function(j) idx[, j]))
  weight <- as.vector(ext)
  weight[idx[seq_len(R), C + 1L]] <- weight[idx[seq_len(R), C + 1L]] + 1e9
  weight[idx[R + 1L, C + 1L]] <- weight[idx[R + 1L, C + 1L]] + 2e9
  weight[rep_len(as.vector(fixed), length(ext))] <- Inf
  s <- suppress_lines(as.vector(ext), lines, init = rep_len(as.vector(init), length(ext)), weight = weight)
  matrix(s, nrow(ext))
}

# One-way frequency table in the interim report's layout: N, % of all, and % excluding N/As.
# `not_reported` lists labels (besides NA) that count as non-substantive. The result carries the
# categories it shows and hides, so a cross-tab of the same variable can match them (see `like`).
tab_one_way <- function(x, label = "Category", order = character(), not_reported = character(),
                        show_valid = TRUE, digits = 1) {
  if (length(x) == 0L) return(tibble(!!label := "No records"))
  x <- if_else(is.na(x), NOT_REPORTED, as.character(x))
  nr_labels <- c(not_reported, NOT_REPORTED)
  counts <- count(tibble(category = x), category)
  present <- counts$category
  lv <- c(intersect(setdiff(order, nr_labels), present),
          sort(setdiff(present, c(order, nr_labels))),
          intersect(nr_labels, present))
  counts <- counts[match(lv, counts$category), ]

  n <- counts$n
  is_sub <- !(counts$category %in% nr_labels)
  m <- length(n)
  i_sub <- m + 1L; i_nr <- m + 2L; i_tot <- m + 3L
  x_all <- c(n, sum(n[is_sub]), sum(n[!is_sub]), sum(n))
  lines <- list(c(which(is_sub), i_sub), c(which(!is_sub), i_nr), c(i_sub, i_nr, i_tot))
  s <- if (SHAREABLE) suppress_lines(x_all, lines) else rep(FALSE, length(x_all))
  sc <- s[seq_len(m)]

  body <- tibble(
    category = counts$category,
    N = if_else(sc, SUPPR, fmt_n(n)),
    `%` = if_else(sc | s[i_tot], SUPPR, fmt_pct(n / x_all[i_tot], digits)),
    `% (excluding N/As)` = case_when(
      !is_sub         ~ "N/A",
      sc | s[i_sub]   ~ SUPPR,
      TRUE            ~ fmt_pct(n / x_all[i_sub], digits)
    )
  )
  subtotal <- tibble(
    category = "Subtotal: substantive responses",
    N = if_else(s[i_sub], SUPPR, fmt_n(x_all[i_sub])),
    `%` = if_else(s[i_sub] | s[i_tot], SUPPR, fmt_pct(x_all[i_sub] / x_all[i_tot], digits)),
    `% (excluding N/As)` = if_else(s[i_sub], SUPPR, "100.0%")
  )
  total <- tibble(category = "Total", N = if_else(s[i_tot], SUPPR, fmt_n(x_all[i_tot])),
                  `%` = if_else(s[i_tot], SUPPR, "100.0%"), `% (excluding N/As)` = "")

  out <- if (show_valid) {
    bind_rows(body[is_sub, ], subtotal, body[!is_sub, ], total)
  } else {
    bind_rows(body, total) |> select(-`% (excluding N/As)`)
  }
  out <- rename(out, !!label := category)
  attr(out, "hidden") <- counts$category[sc]
  attr(out, "shown")  <- counts$category[!sc]
  # A cross-tab of this variable leaves out missing values, so its grand total can be read from this
  # table only when no total and no non-substantive count here is hidden.
  attr(out, "total_hidden") <- any(s[c(which(!is_sub), i_sub, i_nr, i_tot)])
  out
}

# Two-way table with row percentages and counts, e.g. "45% (1,234)", plus a Total row and an N column.
# Every row and column (including the Total row and N column) is a suppression line (see
# `suppress_table()`). A row whose total is hidden shows counts without percentages, because its
# percentages would reveal that total. Rows follow factor level order when `rows` is a factor.
# `like`: an earlier table of the same column variable over the same clients (one-way or two-way).
# Its hidden categories and grand total start hidden in this table's Total row, and the ones it shows
# are never hidden here, so the two tables cannot be combined to recover a suppressed count.
tab_two_way <- function(rows, cols, row_label = "Group", col_order = character(), digits = 0,
                        like = NULL) {
  if (length(rows) == 0L) return(tibble(!!row_label := "No records"))
  row_lv <- as.character(sort(unique(rows[!is.na(rows)])))
  rows <- if_else(is.na(rows), NOT_REPORTED, as.character(rows))
  cols <- if_else(is.na(cols), NOT_REPORTED, as.character(cols))
  if (any(rows == NOT_REPORTED)) row_lv <- c(row_lv, NOT_REPORTED)
  present <- unique(cols)
  col_lv <- c(intersect(setdiff(col_order, NOT_REPORTED), present),
              sort(setdiff(present, c(col_order, NOT_REPORTED))),
              intersect(NOT_REPORTED, present))

  m <- unclass(table(factor(rows, row_lv), factor(cols, col_lv)))
  R <- nrow(m); C <- ncol(m)
  ext <- rbind(cbind(m, rowSums(m)), c(colSums(m), sum(m)))

  s_mat <- matrix(FALSE, R + 1, C + 1)
  if (SHAREABLE) {
    init <- fixed <- matrix(FALSE, R + 1, C + 1)
    if (!is.null(like)) {
      init[R + 1, ]  <- c(col_lv %in% attr(like, "hidden"), isTRUE(attr(like, "total_hidden")))
      fixed[R + 1, ] <- c(col_lv %in% attr(like, "shown"), !init[R + 1, C + 1])
    }
    s_mat <- suppress_table(ext, init, fixed)
  }
  shown_s <- s_mat
  if (SHAREABLE) {
    # In a row or column whose total is below k, zeros are hidden too: otherwise they would show
    # which categories the small group falls into (e.g., a row that is zero everywhere but one cell).
    small_row <- ext[, C + 1] > 0 & ext[, C + 1] < SUPPRESS_N
    small_col <- ext[R + 1, ] > 0 & ext[R + 1, ] < SUPPRESS_N
    shown_s <- s_mat | (ext == 0 & (outer(small_row, rep(TRUE, C + 1)) | outer(rep(TRUE, R + 1), small_col)))
  }

  pct <- ext / ext[, C + 1]
  cell <- matrix(paste0(fmt_pct(pct, digits), " (", fmt_n(ext), ")"), nrow(ext))
  no_pct <- s_mat[, C + 1]                      # rows (including Total) whose total is hidden
  cell[no_pct, ] <- matrix(fmt_n(ext[no_pct, , drop = FALSE]), sum(no_pct))
  cell[shown_s] <- SUPPR
  cell[, C + 1] <- ifelse(s_mat[, C + 1], SUPPR, fmt_n(ext[, C + 1]))
  colnames(cell) <- c(col_lv, "N")
  out <- as_tibble(cell) |> mutate(!!row_label := c(row_lv, "Total"), .before = 1)
  attr(out, "hidden") <- union(attr(like, "hidden"), col_lv[s_mat[R + 1, seq_len(C)]])
  attr(out, "shown")  <- col_lv[!s_mat[R + 1, seq_len(C)]]
  attr(out, "total_hidden") <- s_mat[R + 1, C + 1]
  out
}

# Show a table and keep a copy for the CSV export at the end.
EXPORT <- list()
show_table <- function(tbl, id, caption = NULL) {
  EXPORT[[id]] <<- tbl
  kable(tbl, caption = caption, align = c("l", rep("r", ncol(tbl) - 1)))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cutoff-helpers
# ---- 3.02 helpers ----
fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(as.numeric(x), format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
data_path <- function(file) file.path(cfg$data_dir, file)
read_pairs <- function(file) read_csv(data_path(file), show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)

qa_flow <- tibble(step = character(), n = integer())
qa_add <- function(step, n) qa_flow <<- bind_rows(qa_flow, tibble(step = step, n = as.integer(n)))

# The text of one cell of a table made by `tab_two_way()`; NA if that row or column is not in it.
cell_text <- function(tbl, row, col) {
  if (!col %in% names(tbl) || !row %in% tbl[[1]]) return(NA_character_)
  tbl[[col]][tbl[[1]] == row]
}
is_hidden <- function(tbl, row, col) cell_text(tbl, row, col) %in% SUPPR

# One measure: complete pairs with each score classed against the cut-off (a score at or above it
# is in the clinical range) and, where the measure has a reliable change index, the change classed
# as reliable or not (a drop of at least `rci` points is a reliable improvement).
classify_pairs <- function(d, initial, follow_up, cutoff, rci) {
  d |>
    filter(!is.na(client_system_id), !is.na(.data[[initial]]), !is.na(.data[[follow_up]])) |>
    transmute(
      client_system_id,
      status_initial   = STATUS[(.data[[initial]] >= .env$cutoff) + 1L],
      status_follow_up = STATUS[(.data[[follow_up]] >= .env$cutoff) + 1L],
      movement = factor(paste(status_initial, "to", str_to_lower(status_follow_up)), levels = MOVEMENT$label),
      drop     = .data[[initial]] - .data[[follow_up]],
      # `.env$` because the cleaned Y-OQ and P-OQ files have a column that is also called rci
      change   = RELIABLE[2L + (drop >= .env$rci) - (drop <= -.env$rci)]
    )
}

# Tables for one measure. Returns its row of the summary table.
cutoff_measure <- function(id, measure, file, initial, follow_up, cutoff, rci) {
  cat("\n\n## ", measure, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (!file.exists(data_path(file))) {
    cat("Not analysed: the file `", file, "` was not found in the data folder.\n\n", sep = "")
    qa_add(paste0(measure, ": pairs analysed (file not found)"), 0)
    return(NULL)
  }
  raw <- read_pairs(file)
  d <- classify_pairs(raw, initial, follow_up, cutoff, rci)
  qa_add(paste0(measure, ": rows read"), nrow(raw))
  qa_add(paste0(measure, ": unique clients"), n_distinct(raw$client_system_id))
  qa_add(paste0(measure, ": pairs with both scores"), nrow(d))

  cat("Cut-off: a score of ", cutoff, " or higher is in the clinical range.",
      if (!is.na(rci)) paste0(" Reliable change: ", rci, " points or more."), "\n\n", sep = "")
  moved <- tab_two_way(factor(d$status_initial, STATUS), d$status_follow_up, "Initial score", STATUS, digits = 1)
  show_table(moved, paste0(id, "_cutoff_movement"),
             caption = "Follow-up score by initial score, relative to the cut-off (row percentages)") |> print()

  if (!is.na(rci)) {
    # The Total row of the next table repeats the four cells of the table above, so it starts with
    # the same cells hidden and never hides one that is shown there (see `like` in `tab_two_way()`).
    cell_hidden <- map2_lgl(MOVEMENT$initial, MOVEMENT$follow_up, \(i, f) is_hidden(moved, i, f))
    like <- structure(list(), hidden = MOVEMENT$label[cell_hidden], shown = MOVEMENT$label[!cell_hidden],
                      total_hidden = is_hidden(moved, "Total", "N"))
    cat("\n\nClinically significant improvement is a reliable improvement that also moves the score from the ",
        "clinical range to below the cut-off: the \"", MOVEMENT$label[MOVEMENT$recovered], "\" column of the \"",
        RELIABLE[3], "\" row.\n\n", sep = "")
    tab_two_way(factor(d$change, RELIABLE), d$movement, "Change in score", MOVEMENT$label, digits = 1, like = like) |>
      show_table(paste0(id, "_reliable_change"),
                 caption = "Movement across the cut-off by reliable change (row percentages)") |> print()
  }

  # Summary row: counts in the clinical range are the margins of the first table, so each is hidden
  # here exactly when it is hidden there.
  n <- nrow(d)
  n_clinical <- c(sum(d$status_initial == STATUS[2]), sum(d$status_follow_up == STATUS[2]))
  hide_n <- is_hidden(moved, "Total", "N")
  hide <- c(is_hidden(moved, STATUS[2], "N"), is_hidden(moved, "Total", STATUS[2])) | hide_n
  tibble(Measure = measure, `Cut-off` = as.character(cutoff),
         `N pairs` = if_else(hide_n, SUPPR, fmt_n(n)),
         `In clinical range at initial` = if_else(hide[1], SUPPR, fmt_pct(n_clinical[1] / n)),
         `In clinical range at follow-up` = if_else(hide[2], SUPPR, fmt_pct(n_clinical[2] / n)))
}
```

## Summary: scores in the clinical range at initial and follow-up

```{r}
#| label: summary
show_table(summary_rows, "clinical_range_summary",
           caption = "Share of clients with a score in the clinical range, by tool")
```

## Tools with a cut-off that are not included

- **PSC-35:** the cut-off depends on the child's age (28 for ages 6-17; 24 for ages 3-5, scored on 31 items), so it needs age alongside the paired scores.
- **CATS-2:** the screening thresholds differ by version, and the interim report suppressed every CATS-2 result for small numbers.

# Data quality checks

These counts are for review, not reporting.

```{r}
#| label: qa
qa_flow |>
  mutate(n = fmt_n_qa(n)) |>
  rename(Step = step, N = n) |>
  show_table("qa_sample_flow", caption = "Sample flow")
```

```{r}
#| label: export
export_long <- imap_dfr(EXPORT, function(tbl, id) {
  first <- names(tbl)[1]
  tbl |>
    mutate(across(everything(), as.character), row_order = row_number()) |>
    rename(row = all_of(first)) |>
    pivot_longer(-c(row, row_order), names_to = "column", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(table = id, row_header = first, .before = 1)
}) |>
  mutate(render_mode = RUN_MODE, suppress_n = SUPPRESS_N, .before = 1)

export_path <- file.path(cfg$output_dir, paste0(FILE_TAG, "_tables_", RUN_MODE, ".csv"))
write_csv(export_long, export_path, na = "")
```
